note: Major updates only, newest first. To add one: put a new object at the top of "releases" (id = the date, e.g. 2026-11-04). Tags: New, Improved, Changed, Fixed. Keep each item to one plain sentence, and leave small tweaks and fixes out.

releases.title: Flashcards, break-fix labs, new mini-courses and CySA+

items.text: Flashcards built from each module's Key terms, with Got it and Again buttons that schedule cards for review.
Break-it-then-fix-it and troubleshooting labs, such as a web server that will not restart and a user who cannot print.
Five mini-courses without an exam: Git, Docker, Python for IT, DNS and DHCP, and Active Directory.
CompTIA CySA+ (CS0-004) practice questions across all four domains.

releases.title: Cheat sheets, a subnetting trainer and performance-based practice

items.text: A Reference tab with one-page printable cheat sheets for Network+, CCNA, AZ-104, RHCSA and the Linux paths.
A subnetting trainer with unlimited generated problems, hints and a streak counter, in the Reference tab for networking exams.
A PBQs tab with exam-style timed performance-based sets (matching, ordering, fill-in and firewall rules) for Network+, Security+, CCNA and A+.
One request button now handles both new course requests and feature requests.

releases.title: Make it yours: themes, backgrounds and discussions

items.text: Question discussions: signed-in users can comment under every practice question, using a display name (never your email).
68 color themes, each with a light and a dark version, plus an Appearance page (the palette button beside light/dark) to pick one.
Ten animated backgrounds that follow your theme, or turn them off.
Skills & Topics: three non-certification learning paths (CLI and scripting, help desk, networking in practice).
Fuller explanations with verified documentation links across the Microsoft, AWS, Linux and Google courses.
A course overview page for each course; Recents cards open it.
Labs: hands-on CLI, configuration and admin-console simulations.
Linux courses: LPI Linux Essentials, CompTIA Linux+ and Red Hat RHCSA, with a Linux lab simulator.
The site is now The IT Study Hall, with a new logo, the Monokai Pro look and a light/dark switch.
Medical courses: AAPC CPC, NHA CBCS and NHA CMAA.
